newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco sets December 10 restructuring vote.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco sets December 10 restructuring vote.

text.p: Tenneco Inc said Monday directors set December 10 for a shareowner vote on the company's proposed restructuring.

The board action follows receipt by Tenneco of a favorable Internal Revenue Service ruling on the tax-free nature of the proposal and clearance by the Securities and Exchange Commission of various filings related to the transaction.

As previously announced, the proposal calls for the merger of Tenneco Energy with El Paso Energy Corp and the spin off of Tenneco's Newport News Shipbuilding unit, leaving a "new" Tenneco consisting of automotive parts, packaging and administrative services businesses.
